I added `GET /api/admin/users/recently-created`, restricted to the admin authority. It returns the logins of users created in the last 7 days. I didn't run the build or any tests, so none of this has been compiled yet.

- **Repository:** `UserRepository` has a new derived query, `findAllByCreatedDateAfter(Instant)`.
- **Service:** `UserService.getRecentlyCreatedUserLogins()` computes the 7-day cutoff with `Instant.now(clock)`. It then maps the matching users to their logins.
- **Endpoint:** `UserResource.getRecentlyCreatedUsers()` is mapped to `/users/recently-created`. It sits beside the other admin user endpoints.
- **Clock injection:** `src/main/java/CLAUDE.md` requires an injected `Clock`, and the project had no `Clock` bean. I added `ClockConfiguration` with `Clock.systemUTC()` and gave `UserService` a new `Clock` constructor parameter. I found no `new UserService(...)` calls in `src`, so the extra parameter shouldn't break any construction sites.

The existing `Instant.now()` calls in `UserService` still don't use the clock. I left them alone since they're outside this task.

I didn't update `notes/`. There is no `notes/index.md` in this project, so there was nothing to maintain. I also didn't add a test.
